originality.rationale: The asserted addition is only the sharp explicit coefficient of the synthesis-rate cusp width and balance-line slope at arbitrary positive unequal Hill exponents. The underlying toggle, qualitative cusp and bistability, and generic 3/2 law are all known. The full primary 2000 and 2019 texts inspected do not state this explicit all-real-exponent coefficient. The broader 2021 work is acknowledged; inaccessible main body remains a risk.
residual_risks: The full main body of Guilberteau–Pouchol–Pouradier Duteil (2021) was inaccessible, although its abstract and appendix were inspected.
The 2013 instructional preprint was only accessible as an abstract.
An exact explicit rate-width coefficient could be present in an uninspected manuscript or be derivable from already-published full parameterizations; no exhaustive priority claim is made.

value.rationale: The exact cusp-width prefactor and first-order balance slope are directly motivated by tolerance of a synthetic toggle to synthesis-rate mismatch near the minimum synthesis threshold. It quantifies how the robust operating window shrinks under unequal positive Hill cooperativities. It is not merely the known existence of a cusp or its generic exponent; experimental performance is not implied.
